issue.body:
## Outcome

Produce one accepted GCP hierarchy and cost-envelope decision.

## Primary deliverable

One accepted decision register binding organization, folders, projects, billing, region, quota, naming, data residency, and the first workload cost envelope.

## Verification result

Read-only hierarchy, billing, API, IAM, policy, network, quota, credit-expiry, and current-resource observations reconcile to the decision register.

## Unit boundary

Issue completion is exactly one accepted hierarchy-and-cost decision; discovery observations are evidence inputs and no cloud mutation is performed.

## Dependencies

- None.

## Retained predecessor scope

- None; this is new v0.92.1 work.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Organization folder project billing and region are exact
- [ ] POC and long-term ownership are explicit
- [ ] The first workload has a hard cost ceiling
- [ ] Quota is not treated as capacity

## Owned paths

- `docs/operations/cloud/gcp/decisions/**`
- `docs/milestones/v0.92.1/evidence/cloud/gcp-a/**`

## PVF lanes

- `hierarchy-readback`
- `billing-and-credit`
- `iam-policy-census`
- `quota-capacity`
- `decision-denominator`

## Stop conditions

- Identity or billing is ambiguous
- Credit expiry is unknown
- A decision would require mutation

## Non-goals

- API enablement
- Project creation
- Paid launch
